description_en: Queries the auto scaling settings of a cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoScaleConfig查询指定集群的自动伸缩配置信息
name: DescribeAutoScaleConfig

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the associated cluster

ClusterType.description_en:
The type of the scheduler. Valid values:

pbs
slurm
opengridscheduler
deadline
ClusterType.description_zh:
集群的调度器类型。可能值：
pbs
slurm
opengridscheduler
deadline

EnableAutoGrow.description_en: Specifies whether to enable auto scale-out

EnableAutoShrink.description_en: Specifies whether to enable auto scale-in

ExcludeNodes.description_en: The list of nodes on which auto scaling is not enabled
ExcludeNodes.description_zh: 不使用自动伸缩的节点列表

ExtraNodesGrowRatio.description_en: The percentage of extra compute nodes. Valid values: 0 to 100
ExtraNodesGrowRatio.description_zh: 额外节点百分比。可能值：0~100

GrowIntervalInMinutes.description_en: The interval between two consecutive rounds of scale-in. Valid values: 2 to 10
GrowIntervalInMinutes.description_zh: 扩容时间间隔，每轮计算节点扩容的时间间隔。可能值：2~10

GrowRatio.description_en: The percentage of each round of scale-out. Valid values: 1 to 100

GrowTimeoutInMinutes.description_en: The timeout period before the scale-out nodes were started. Valid values: 10 to 60
GrowTimeoutInMinutes.description_zh: 扩容超时时间，等待启动节点的超时时间。可能值：10~60

MaxNodesInCluster.description_en: The maximum number of compute nodes in the cluster. This parameter indicates the largest number of nodes that can be added to the cluster
MaxNodesInCluster.description_zh: 集群最大计算节点数，集群最多可以扩展的节点数量

ShrinkIdleTimes.description_en: The number of consecutive idle times of a node during the resource shrink check. Valid values: 2 to 5
ShrinkIdleTimes.description_zh: 节点连续空闲次数，资源收缩检查时，一个节点连续处于空闲的次数。可能值：2~5

ShrinkIntervalInMinutes.description_en: The interval between two consecutive rounds of scale-out. Valid values: 2 to 10
ShrinkIntervalInMinutes.description_zh: 缩容时间间隔，每轮计算节点收缩的时间间隔。可能值：2~10

SpotPriceLimit.description_en: The maximum hourly price of the new ECS instance. The value is accurate to three decimal places. It takes effect only when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
SpotPriceLimit.description_zh: 实例的每小时最高价格。支持最多3位小数，参数SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The bidding method of the compute nodes. Valid values:

NoSpot: The instances of the compute node are pay-as-you-go instances.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is created as a preemptible instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is a preemptible instance for which the market price at the time of purchase is automatically used as the bidding price
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
计算节点竞价策略。可能值：
NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格
